title: Ask FPS
intro: Answers come from pages already on this preview. Your question stays in this browser. Nothing is sent or stored.
agentNote: A later version could run as a ChatGPT Business Agent once brokerages qualify. OpenAI’s Businesses in ChatGPT beta lets eligible US businesses claim a profile, keep details current, and see aggregated insights. This demo does not connect to ChatGPT.

fallback.text: I can only answer from this preview. For a private readiness check, use the Seller Scorecard. To see practices, open listings. To talk with a person, contact Karl.

entries.text: The Seller Scorecard is a private self-check. It scores financial evidence, revenue, the lease, the team, systems, AI visibility, and technology and data. You get a band, ranked actions, and a planning window. Your first name, last name, email, and cell phone are required before the result is shown. Details go only to Frye Practice Sales.

For many single-location Arizona general practices, the published guide uses about 60% to 85% of annual collections as orientation only. It is not a valuation. Profit, hygiene, the lease, equipment, and how patients stay without the owner move the number. Karl still does a confidential review before any asking price.

Selling starts with a confidential conversation about timing and goals, then a valuation, a prospectus, buyer matching, and a coordinated close. Staff and patients are part of the plan. You can start with the Seller Scorecard if you want a private picture first.
Buyers can review current listings and ask about financing, diligence, and fit. Full listing details are shared after an NDA. Karl can also walk through what lenders tend to look at.
Listings on this preview are confidential. The page shows the city and a short description, not the exact address. Ask Karl for the NDA if you want the full file.

A weak or unclear lease can slow a sale even when the numbers look fine. A Frye Practice Sales broker can review your lease and real estate options with you, including assignment, renewal options, and landlord consent. If you own the building, that same conversation covers a sale or leaseback.

The Seller Scorecard stands on its own. Frye Practice Advisory offers a Practice Value Check, a Readiness Assessment, a Technology and Data Audit with a dental IT partner, an Owner KPI Dashboard, a Staffing and Pay Benchmark, Pre-Sale Diligence Prep, a Value-Building Retainer, and an AI and online presence cleanup. For this pilot those are by conversation, not a posted price. Book a free 20-minute call. Frye Practice Advisory is a separate affiliate from Frye Practice Sales. Separate agreement and billing. No fee sharing. You are free to choose any broker.

Patients and buyers now find practices through AI assistants as well as search. The scorecard asks whether the Google Business Profile and the ChatGPT Business Hub profile are claimed, and whether hours, services, insurance, and recent reviews are in good shape. The proposed cleanup add-on covers Google, ChatGPT Business Hub, Yelp, and Healthgrades.

Technology and data is the seventh Seller Scorecard area. It asks which software you use, such as Dentrix, Dentrix Ascend, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve Dental, or Denticon, whether that software is cloud-based or on a server in the office, and how old the office computers are. Newer computers and cloud software score higher. Computers older than 5 years point to a quick win: plan upgrades, and check Windows 11 and HIPAA readiness. It also asks about the monthly IT fee and whether key numbers are in one place each month. A software-subscription list is a deeper follow-up in the Practice Value Check, not a Seller Scorecard question. An optional question covers a HIPAA risk assessment, backups, and cybersecurity in the last 12 months. DSO buyers move every practice onto their own systems. Old computers and unclear data can become a price cut in diligence.

The Practice Value Check is the next conversation after the Seller Scorecard, before full Sell-Ready Advisory. For this pilot it is by conversation, not a posted price. Book a free 20-minute call. It covers a short review of financials, staff cost versus local pay, the tech stack, and the top five value fixes. A software-subscription list can be part of that deeper review. Frye Practice Advisory is separate from Frye Practice Sales. Separate agreement and billing. No fee sharing. You are free to choose any broker. The work aims to improve the file a buyer will read. It does not promise a higher price.

Frye Practice Sales is the brokerage. Karl lists and sells the practice. Frye Practice Advisory is a separate affiliate for pre-sale readiness advice, with a separate agreement and billing. Owners often wait because they do not want the staff or the town to hear about a sale too soon. The process is built to stay confidential until you choose otherwise. Talk with Karl about how that works for your office.
Buyers look at whether care and collections continue if the owner steps back. Measuring owner, associate, and hygiene production, and writing a coverage plan, is one of the longer scorecard actions.
